data.name: Laxmikanta
data.gender_notes: Laxmikanta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God of Wealth, Fortune and Prosperity
data.long_meaning: Laxmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, fortune, prosperity, and the embodiment of beauty, fertility, and the bestower of earthly pleasures. Kanta refers to Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. The name Laxmikanta carries the meaning “God of Wealth, Fortune and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Laxmikanta usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth, fortune and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and wealth in all forms. It is a reminder to focus on the inner richness and abundance rather than external material wealth.
data.etymology: Laxmikanta belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wealth, Fortune and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laxmikanta total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Laxmikanta reflects the profound reverence for the goddess Laxmi and Lord Vishnu in Hindu culture. It symbolizes the importance of prosperity and wealth, not just in materialistic terms, but also as a means to lead a comfortable and contented life, able to take care of oneself and one’s family.
data.spiritual_significance: This name carries the deep spiritual meaning that true wealth lies in the blessings and protection of the divine, embodied in the forms of Laxmi and Vishnu. It is a reminder to seek spiritual prosperity and inner richness, rather than relying solely on material possessions. The name Laxmikanta is a beautiful blend of the material (Laxmi) and the spiritual (Vishnu), symbolizing a harmonious balance in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Laxmikanta is a name revered in Hinduism, symbolizing the divine union of wealth (Laxmi) and wisdom (Kanta). It signifies the attainment of material prosperity coupled with spiritual knowledge.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Laxmikanta is a name of Vishnu in Hindu mythology The name Laxmikanta carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Laxmikanta is a manifestation of Vishnu, the preserver god, and is often depicted with his consort Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Laxmikanta remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
